title: Min Aung Hlaing to Visit Vietnam Sept 4-6 in Latest ASEAN Re-Engagement Push
detail: Myanmar state media announced on September 1, 2026 that President Min Aung Hlaing will make an official visit to Vietnam from September 4-6 at the invitation of Vietnamese President To Lam, meeting Prime Minister Pham Minh Chinh and National Assembly chairman Tran Thanh Man. It will be his fourth visit to an ASEAN member state since becoming civilian president in April 2026, following trips to Laos (early July) and Thailand (August 6-7), with a visit to Cambodia also planned for early September. The announcement follows a visit to Naypyidaw last week by Vietnamese Foreign Minister Bui Thanh Son — the first by a Vietnamese foreign minister since the 2021 coup — as part of Min Aung Hlaing's broader campaign to normalize Myanmar's standing within ASEAN.

media.caption: Myanmar President Min Aung Hlaing, who will visit Vietnam September 4-6, 2026.

title: Junta Airstrike on Mawchi Tungsten Mining Town Kills 5, Wounds 7 in Karenni State
detail: Around 4 p.m. on September 1, 2026, Myanmar Air Force jets bombed the Kyauk Kyar neighborhood of Mawchi — a centuries-old tin and tungsten mining town in Hpasawng Township, Karenni (Kayah) State controlled by a Karenni resistance alliance since 2024 — killing 5 civilians and wounding 7, some critically, and damaging homes. No fighting had been reported in the immediate area before the strike; regime forces have held neighboring Hpasawng town since February 15, 2026, and have surveilled the mining town with reconnaissance drones since April. A separate wave of junta bombing the same week hit other resistance-held areas of Mandalay and Karenni, killing a combined 7 more civilians.
